digest.component_or_area: workflow step registration and seam tests
propositions: plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC) lack headroom assertions despite exceeding 700-line policy threshold
test_gate_dispatch_seam.py's assertion message references finalize_verdict call sites in gate_dispatch.py when all five sites are actually in plan_review_recovery.py and plan_review/workflow_ops.py
missing registration imports cannot be caught statically because STEP_REGISTRY is populated purely as import side effect and may be masked by test ordering or pre-existing imports in the process
gate-YAML resolution test and step-registry membership test must run in subprocess isolation with clean sys.modules to detect defects that are invisible to in-process assertions
workflow schema treats step names as free-form strings and lint skips validation of unknown steps by design leaving only runtime errors as detection
headroom assertions must use staged thresholds (<800 now, tightening to <700 after extraction) to land independently of refactors while protecting policy
